title: fix(plugin-detail): Enter on a link inside a copy-on-activate details row opens the link instead of copying the row
body:
Fixes #12569
Clause-②: no. No export, prop, type member or i18n key is added or removed; the change is inside one module-private function and the two key handlers that read it.

## What changed

A read-only details row that offers copy (`record:details`, `DetailSection`) is a `role="button"` with `tabIndex=0`. Its `onKeyDown` called `preventDefault` and copied the row's raw value on Enter or Space whatever the key's target was. A key pressed on a link drawn inside the row bubbles to that handler, so Enter on a lookup link copied the row value and the link did not open.

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`: one module-private predicate, `isRowActivationKey(e)`, answers "Enter or Space whose target IS the row" (`e.target === e.currentTarget`). Both row shapes read it: the mobile grouped-inset row and the default row. A key aimed at anything focusable inside the row (a link, the row's own hover copy button, an input) is left to that element: no `preventDefault`, no copy.
- Unchanged: the row's click handler; Enter and Space on the row itself (they still copy and still consume the key); Escape; inline editing (rows with `canInlineEditField` still carry no copy handler on the default layout).
- Not touched: PR objectui#12568's Enter stop on the record-preview card's title link stays as it is (the ruling keeps it); no per-link workaround is added.
- `.changeset/12569-copy-row-descendant-keys.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `patch`.

## Measurements behind the route

- **A1 (which component draws the inner link).** On the served `sys_approval_request_detail` page the Details grid's "Record ID" row draws the `referenceVia` pair through `RecordPreviewCard`; the card's highlight strip (`HeaderHighlight`) draws the target's lookup value through the lookup cell renderer, whose anchor is `ReferencedRecordLink` (`@object-ui/fields`). The served-page pin asserts the link's nearest `role="button"` ancestor is the Record ID row (`DetailSection`'s default row).
- **A1 harness note.** The request row is a copy row only because the object is `managedBy: 'engine-owned'`, as `plugin-approvals` declares it. Without that key the harness draws the row inline-editable (measured: the row carried the "Double-click to edit" title and no `role`), and Enter on the link passes for the wrong reason. The new served-page pin declares it.
- **A2 (mouse clicks).** A click on the inner link opens the record and copies nothing, before and after: `ReferencedRecordLink`'s `onClick` calls `stopPropagation`, so the row's `onClick` never runs. Pinned as UNCHANGED in both layouts (the click hands the target to the host's `openRecord`; nothing reaches the clipboard; a click on the row itself still copies).
- **A3.** The served-page pin mounts the root `SchemaRendererProvider dataSource={adapter}` as `ConsoleShell` does.

## Tests

New, on the `DetailSection` unit (`packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.copyRowDescendantKeys-12569.test.tsx`), every case in both row shapes:
- Enter on a descendant link: `fireEvent.keyDown` returns `true` (not default-prevented) and nothing is copied;
- Enter on a focused descendant link (via `user-event`, which dispatches the click only when keydown was not prevented): the host's `openRecord` receives `('account', 'acc-2')`, nothing copied;
- Space on a descendant link: not prevented, nothing copied;
- UNCHANGED: Enter / Space on the row itself copy the value and are consumed;
- CONTROL: Escape on the row and on the link is neither prevented nor copies;
- UNCHANGED (measured A2): a mouse click on the inner link opens and does not copy;
- default row only: Enter on the row's own hover copy button copies exactly once (through the button); a row with no copy handler (inline-editable) lets its link open.
Every absence-shaped case closes with Enter on the row itself in the same tree and requires the copy.

New served-page pin (`apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPageLookupEnter-12569.test.tsx`), the real `RecordDetailView` under the root provider: the link sits inside the Record ID copy row; Enter on it routes to the account record path and copies nothing; CONTROL: Enter on the row itself copies the raw record id.

Runs:
- Pre-fix (new unit file against base `1b28dbf270`): 6 failed, 10 passed. The six are exactly the descendant cases (Enter not prevented, Enter opens, Space not prevented) in both layouts; every row-itself and control case was green.
- Post-fix: unit file 16/16; served-page file 4/4.
- Ablation (fix committed first; `node ../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the line `if (e.target !== e.currentTarget) return false;`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `856ef124f647` to `0338ebd22384`): 7 failed, 13 passed across both files. Red: the six descendant cases plus the served-page Enter pin. Green: every row-itself, Escape, mouse-click, copy-button and no-copy-handler case, and the served-page structure and row-itself pins. Restore proven by the tool: blob equals the HEAD blob `856ef124f647` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

Union, on head `6ace8cb335` (the final commit):
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3 packages/plugin-detail/ apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource`: Test Files 283 passed, 1 skipped (284 = 274 plugin-detail files + 10 approval files); Tests 2751 passed, 14 skipped; exit 0.
- Census and ratchet sweep (`git grep -l -E 'census|ratchet|WRITE_SITES|AFFORDANCE_GRANTS' -- '*.test.ts*'`, narrowed to the 52 files naming a touched subject: `DetailSection`, `plugin-detail/src`, `.changeset/`, `onKeyDown`, `approvalRequestsDataSource`): the 4 under plugin-detail ran in the union above; the other 48: 48 files, 2009 tests passed, exit 0.

## Gates (local subset; CI runs the full farm)

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' build`: exit 0 (12 of 47 projects).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0; `--listFiles` on the test program names the new unit file.
- Changeset gates: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`: all exit 0; `census:changeset-polarity` names nothing of this change.
- `check:control-bytes`: exit 0. `check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, 0 new citations.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three changed source files: exit 0, 0 errors; the 12 warnings in `DetailSection.tsx` all sit on lines outside this diff's hunks.
- `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:unreferenced-sources`: all exit 0.
- Declared to CI, not run locally: the console `type-check` that covers the new served-page test (it needs the whole console closure built), repo-wide `pnpm lint`, the sharded `pnpm test`, the performance budget and e2e.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the four paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## What the landing seat's browser reading should show

On a served approval request page (HotCRM `sys_approval_request_detail`), Details tab, desktop width:
1. Tab to the target card's lookup link ("ACC-000002 - Globex Industries" in the reported instance) and press Enter: the account's record page opens. The clipboard does not receive the request's raw record id.
2. Tab to the Record ID row itself (the focus ring is on the whole row) and press Enter, then Space: each puts the raw record id on the clipboard. Unchanged.
3. Click the lookup link with the mouse: the account opens and nothing is copied. Unchanged.
4. Tab to the card's title link and press Enter: the target record opens. Unchanged.
5. Optional, below 768 px: the grouped-inset row behaves the same for steps 1 and 2.

## Acceptance notes

- `RecordPreviewCard`'s title link keeps its own Enter `stopPropagation` (the ruling keeps it). Its two comments that explain it ("the link keeps its click and its Enter to itself"; "The row's Enter copies and prevents the default, which would cancel the link's own activation") now describe a row behaviour this change removes; the stop is redundant but harmless. Not filed; carrier: none.
- The existing served-page harness `approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPageRecordLink-12557.test.tsx` declares the request object without `managedBy: 'engine-owned'`, so its Record ID row renders inline-editable where the served page draws a copy row (measured in this run, see A1 harness note). Its pins do not depend on the row kind. Not filed; carrier: none.
- Reach, read from the code and not separately measured in a browser: the mobile grouped-inset row gates its copy handler on `copyOffered` alone, so below 768 px an inline-editable row in read mode also carried the defect; and any focusable cell content in a copy row (`tel:` / `mailto:` / URL cells, the permission-facet link) was cancelled the same way. The row-level rule covers all of them; the unit pins measure the mobile shape on a read-only lookup row.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
